svg.title: MiniFrontier Edu architecture
svg.desc: Decoder-only stack: tokens, tied embedding, two identical transformer blocks, final RMSNorm and tied lm_head. One block is expanded to show pre-RMSNorm, full-causal multi-head attention with RoPE, a residual add, a second pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU feed-forward and a second residual add.
svg.text: q / k / v proj · 4 heads each
